patterns.description: The slide is a table-of-contents layout with a title on the left and five numbered section rows on the right.
The repeated section label text suggests placeholder content intended to be replaced with actual section names.
Top and bottom areas contain repeated connector grids and inherited images that appear decorative rather than editable content.
Bottom corner images appear to be fixed branding elements rather than replaceable slide content.

constraints.description: Each visible agenda row pairs one number object with one label object in a horizontal arrangement.
The visible numbering skips 03, so sequential numbering should not be assumed as a hard requirement without further evidence.
